answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the timber of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the quill of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
